criteria.requirement: Identify shareholder capital-increase authority versus valid delegation.
criteria.pass: Treats new subscribed capital as AGM statutory-amendment decision unless a currently valid authorized-capital mandate exists; board cannot rely on expired 2020 authorization.
criteria.fail: Allows board alone to issue under the expired clause.

sourceRefs.quote: L'augmentation du capital est décidée par l'assemblée générale aux conditions requises pour la modification des statuts
une durée maximale de cinq ans

factRefs.quote: No extension or renewal has been approved or published.

criteria.minimalPass: 2020 delegation ran out by 2025; proceed through valid AGM resolution, not independent 2026 board issuance.
criteria.nearMiss: Five-year authority remains good because EUR 500k capacity was unused.

criteria.requirement: Compute first-meeting quorum against total share capital.
criteria.pass: Computes 600 of 1,000 shares present, exceeding statutory one-half quorum, with proposed capital article on agenda.
criteria.fail: Calls meeting inquorate because only 390 voted yes or uses voters rather than represented capital for quorum.

sourceRefs.quote: la moitié au moins du capital est représentée

criteria.minimalPass: The amended capital article was on the agenda; 600/1,000=60% represented, exceeding the first-meeting 50% quorum.

criteria.requirement: Compute two-thirds expressed-vote majority excluding abstentions.
criteria.pass: Counts 390 for and 150 against as 540 expressed, excludes 60 abstentions, calculates 390/540=72.22%, so the capital amendment passes the two-thirds threshold on stated votes.
criteria.fail: Uses a bare majority or counts abstentions as votes expressed and reaches the wrong result.

sourceRefs.quote: les deux tiers au moins des voix exprimées
s'est abstenu ou a voté blanc ou nul

criteria.minimalPass: 390/(390+150)=72.22%; the statutory amendment majority is met.

criteria.requirement: Distinguish approval of increase from third-party allocation.
criteria.pass: Explains passing capital amendment does not itself waive statutory preferential subscription rights or authorize all 300 cash shares for Larch immediately.
criteria.fail: Treats the passed increase as automatic suppression of holder rights.

sourceRefs.quote: Les actions à souscrire en numéraire doivent être offertes par préférence aux actionnaires proportionnellement

factRefs.quote: Investor Larch Ventures wants all 300 new cash shares

criteria.minimalPass: Increase passes, but existing shareholders have first preference on cash shares before Larch can take unexercised shares.
criteria.nearMiss: 72.22% yes means the investor can sign for 300 shares tomorrow.

criteria.requirement: Identify defective suppression notice and report.
criteria.pass: If pursuing exclusion, requires a specially announced AGM proposal and detailed board justification including issue price; identifies both omissions in current file and proposes a properly convened new vote or valid delegation route.
criteria.fail: Says board may silently waive the right after meeting or that current notice/report suffice.

sourceRefs.quote: Cette proposition doit être spécialement annoncée dans la convocation.
La justification détaillée doit être exposée dans un rapport établi par le conseil d'administration

factRefs.quote: It did not announce any proposal to limit or suppress the preferential subscription right.
The board has not produced any justification of exclusion of preference rights or price of the Larch placement.

criteria.minimalPass: Do not exclude on the present notice; prepare price-justified board report and specially noticed resolution.
criteria.nearMiss: The board can waive preference unilaterally because the issue price equals par.

criteria.requirement: Present compliant offer alternative and minimum exercise window.
criteria.pass: Explains proportional preference for cash shares and an exercise period of at least 14 days (reckoned from publication when the offer is published); because all shares are registered, registered-letter notice may replace publication, while a different guaranteed notification route needs individual acceptance. Does not impose publication as indispensable or start the period before valid notice.
criteria.fail: Issues shares immediately to Larch, gives only 48 hours, or insists registered-letter notification is invalid solely because it is not publication.

sourceRefs.quote: ne peut être inférieur à quatorze jours à compter de la publication de l’offre
lorsque toutes les actions sont nominatives, les actionnaires peuvent être informés par lettre recommandée

factRefs.quote: All shares are registered; holders have not individually accepted an alternative notice method.

criteria.minimalPass: Offer cash shares pro rata, allow at least 14 days; for all-registered shares use registered letters instead of publication, or obtain individual acceptance for another guaranteed notice method.
criteria.nearMiss: Publish or email holders with a 48-hour deadline; registered letters cannot replace publication.

criteria.requirement: Quantify the share issuance and resulting subscribed capital.
criteria.pass: Calculates 300 new EUR 1,000 shares, EUR 300,000 subscribed cash and EUR 1,300,000 resulting subscribed capital, keeping this transaction math distinct from the vote percentages.
criteria.fail: Gets share count, cash proceeds or resulting capital materially wrong or omits the numeric consequences.

sourceRefs.quote: L'augmentation du capital est décidée par l'assemblée générale

factRefs.quote: 1,000 ordinary EUR 1,000 shares and EUR 1,000,000 subscribed capital
all 300 new cash shares at EUR 1,000 each, taking capital to EUR 1,300,000

criteria.minimalPass: 300 × EUR 1,000 = EUR 300,000 cash; subscribed capital rises from EUR 1m to EUR 1.3m.
criteria.nearMiss: The increase creates EUR 300,000 new shares and subscribed capital of EUR 1.03m.
